transforms.code: return False if value['startDate'] < value['endDate'] else True

page = 'designer' if '/' in value['page'] else value['page']
	info = system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgetFilters(value['page'], value['viewParams'], value['sessionCustomProps'], self.session.props.device.timezone.id)
	info['oeeEnabled'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('oeeEnabled', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': info['assetPath']}))
	
	# Not persistent: the range is this selector's own (setRange keeps it on the view), so a re-run caused by another
	# change to session.custom.kanoa doesn't put the page's stored range back over it (868mwak13)
	display = value['viewParams'].get('display') if value['viewParams'] else None
	if display and display.get('persistent') is False:
		current = self.custom.session
		# Only a range this selector set itself in this session: 'local' holds the session's id. The view's saved value is a
		# design-time range, and a Designer save stores it with the Designer's 'local' too (#493 saved local: True with no
		# range selected, so Production Counts opened blank on the save's dates), so a range from another session is ignored
		if current and current.has_key('dateRange') and current['dateRange'] and current['dateRange'].has_key('local') and current['dateRange']['local'] == self.session.props.id:
			info['dateRange'] = {'startDate': current['dateRange']['startDate'], 'endDate': current['dateRange']['endDate'], 'selectedRange': current['dateRange']['selectedRange'], 'local': self.session.props.id}
	
	return info

# display.autoRefreshHidden hides the toggle but keeps the timer running for Current Run / Current Shift, as if the
	# toggle were on (at the default interval), so the range's end keeps moving to now (868mwzcch)
	hidden = value['display'].has_key('autoRefreshHidden') and value['display']['autoRefreshHidden']
	on = hidden or (value['autoRefresh'] and value['display'].has_key('showAutoRefresh') and value['display']['showAutoRefresh'])
	return on and value['selectedRange'] in ('Current Run', 'Current Shift')

options = []
	items = value['options']
	
	for item in items:
		if item['enabled'] : 
			if ('Shift' in item['label'] or 'Run' in item['label']) and not value['oeeEnabled']: continue
			options.append({'value': item['label'], 'label': item['label']})
		
	return options

config.script:
# Back to the range before the last drag-to-zoom (setDateRange): a named range (Year To Date...) is worked out again
	stack = list(self.view.custom.zoomStack or [])
	if not stack: return
	last = stack.pop()
	self.view.custom.zoomStack = stack
	self.view.getChild("root").setRange(last['selectedRange'] or 'Custom', last['startDate'], last['endDate'])
	try:
		mine = self.view.params.value['id']
	except:
		mine = None
	if not mine: return
	# Tell the page the range a zoom set (the Production page loads its chart for it: dateRangeZoomed)
	dr = self.view.custom.session.dateRange if self.view.custom.session is not None and self.view.custom.session.has_key('dateRange') else None
	if dr is not None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('dateRangeZoomed', {'id': mine, 'startDate': dr['startDate'], 'endDate': dr['endDate']}, scope='page')

customMethods.name: setRange
customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print("setRange() called with %s %s %s" %(selectedRange, startDate, endDate))	

	if selectedRange != 'Custom':
		assetPath = self.view.custom.session['assetPath'] if self.view.custom.session.has_key('assetPath') else None
		paramsDict = {'assetPath': assetPath, 'selectedDateRange': selectedRange, 'clientTZ': self.session.props.device.timezone.id}
		startDate, endDate = system.kanoa.date.getDateRange(paramsDict)
#		system.perspective.print("getDateRange() called with %s returned %s %s"%(paramsDict, startDate, endDate))
	
	if self.view.params.value.display.has_key('persistent') and not self.view.params.value.display['persistent']:
#		system.perspective.print("Setting local dates to %s %s as this is not persistent"%(startDate, endDate))
		# selectedRange too, so the dropdown shows Custom for a picked date (868mwak13)
		self.view.custom.session.dateRange = {'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'selectedRange': selectedRange, 'local': self.session.props.id}
	else:
#		system.perspective.print("storeDateRangeSelection() called with %s %s"%(startDate, endDate))
		system.kanoa.utilities.storeDateRangeSelection(self, startDate, endDate, selectedRange)
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("dateRangeSessionChanged", {})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('dateSelectorUpdate', {})
	
	return

customMethods.name: incrementRange
customMethods.script:
if increment != 0:
		period = self.view.custom.period
		startDate = self.view.custom.session.dateRange.startDate
		endDate = self.view.custom.session.dateRange.endDate
		
		if period == 'Day':
			startDate = system.date.addDays(startDate, increment)
			endDate = system.date.addDays(endDate, increment)
		elif period == 'Week':
			startDate = system.date.addWeeks(startDate, increment)
			endDate = system.date.addWeeks(endDate, increment)
		elif period == 'Month':
			startDate = system.date.addMonths(startDate, increment)
			endDate = system.date.addMonths(endDate, increment)
		elif period == 'Year':
			startDate = system.date.addYears(startDate, increment)
			endDate = system.date.addYears(endDate, increment)
						
	# Not persistent: the range is this selector's own, as in setRange (868mwak13)
	if self.view.params.value.display.has_key('persistent') and not self.view.params.value.display['persistent']:
		self.view.custom.session.dateRange = {'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'selectedRange': 'Custom', 'local': self.session.props.id}
		return
	
#	system.perspective.print("calling storeDateRangeSelection() with %s %s %s"%(startDate, endDate, selectedRange))
	system.kanoa.utilities.storeDateRangeSelection(self, startDate, endDate, 'Custom')
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("dateRangeSessionChanged", {})
		
	return

messageHandlers.script:
#	system.perspective.print("updateDateSelector() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	selectedRange = payload['selectedRange'] if payload.has_key('selectedRange') and payload['selectedRange'] else self.view.params.dates.selectedRange	
	self.setRange(selectedRange, None, None)
	
	return

# Another component sets a Custom range on this selector, e.g. a box dragged across a Production Counts chart: only the
	# selector whose id (params.value.id) the message names
	try:
		mine = self.view.params.value['id']
	except:
		mine = None
	if not mine or not payload or payload.get('id') != mine: return
	if payload.get('startDate') is None or payload.get('endDate') is None: return
	# The range it's already on, or a repeat of the last one (a chart can send its selection twice): nothing to do
	dr = self.view.custom.session.dateRange if self.view.custom.session is not None and self.view.custom.session.has_key('dateRange') else None
	same = lambda a, b: a is not None and b is not None and abs(system.date.toMillis(a) - system.date.toMillis(b)) < 1000
	if dr is not None and same(dr['startDate'], payload['startDate']) and same(dr['endDate'], payload['endDate']): return
	now = system.date.toMillis(system.date.now())
	if now - (self.view.custom.zoomLast or 0) < 2000: return
	self.view.custom.zoomLast = now
	# The range this replaces, so Zoom out (icoZoomOut) can go back to it; each drag adds one
	dr = self.view.custom.session.dateRange if self.view.custom.session is not None and self.view.custom.session.has_key('dateRange') else None
	if dr is not None:
		stack = list(self.view.custom.zoomStack or [])
		stack.append({'selectedRange': dr['selectedRange'], 'startDate': dr['startDate'], 'endDate': dr['endDate']})
		self.view.custom.zoomStack = stack
	self.setRange('Custom', payload['startDate'], payload['endDate'])
	# Tell the page the range a zoom set (the Production page loads its chart for it: dateRangeZoomed)
	dr = self.view.custom.session.dateRange if self.view.custom.session is not None and self.view.custom.session.has_key('dateRange') else None
	if dr is not None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('dateRangeZoomed', {'id': mine, 'startDate': dr['startDate'], 'endDate': dr['endDate']}, scope='page')
